chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from al-Nawfali, from al-Sakuni, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) that
the Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) used to recite:
'And indeed I fear my relatives after me'
— meaning that he (Zakariyya) did not have an inheritor until God granted him one after old age.

key_terms.الْكِبَرُ: old age — Zakariyya's advanced age made childbearing seem impossible
key_terms.الْمَوَالِيَ: relatives/heirs — those who inherit in the absence of a son
key_terms.وَارِثٌ: inheritor/heir — one who inherits property and continues the lineage

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Ali recite from Surah Maryam about Zakariyya and his fear of having no heir?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) reports that Imam Ali (peace be upon him) used to recite Quran 19:5, the supplication of Prophet Zakariyya (peace be upon him) who feared having no heir. The hadith explains that Zakariyya's fear was precisely that he had no inheritor, until God blessed him with Yahya (John) despite his old age. This narration contextualizes the verse and highlights the theme of divine grace in granting offspring, placing it in the context of the chapter on the merits of having a son.
